analysis: PORTFOLIO REVIEW: Five positions are all within tolerable ranges — AMP is the only meaningful winner (+3.43%). MCO, NVDA, and TMUS are all modestly underwater but have not hit stops or broken thesis. Portfolio heat is low at 1.70%, which is healthy given the mixed regime. No position requires an immediate exit. PERFORMANCE CONTEXT: The track record (12.5% win rate, profit factor 0.04x, Sortino -11.38) is a hard warning signal. The strategy is not generating alpha. This demands maximum selectivity — proposing trades just to stay active would be the worst mistake. MARKET REGIME: MIXED. SPY is essentially flat vs SMA50, with only a modest positive 20d slope. This is not a high-conviction environment for new entries. CAPACITY: Only $9,800 of headroom remains for new buys after the 95% gross cap is applied. This constrains sizing to roughly one small position. NEW TRADE DECISION: Of the 30 candidates, ADBE stands out as the one genuinely asymmetric setup. It is trading at 9.31x forward earnings and PEG 0.64 — historically cheap for a company with 61.9% ROE, $9.1B FCF, 34.8% operating margins, and 12.9% revenue growth. It sits at 37% of its 52-week range, still -3.1% vs SMA200 (not extended), with SMA50 slope accelerating at +10.4%. This is a quality company in early-stage recovery, not a chasing-the-high entry. Earnings are 84 days out (Dec 9), giving a clean holding window. The limited headroom caps position size to ~38 shares (~$9,800), producing a small but properly sized risk position. All other candidates are either too extended (CPAY 90%, TRV 87%, NTAP 85%, A 82%, ZBRA 78%), have mixed/declining fundamentals (MOS negative FCF, ROE -5.1%), have earnings too soon (FDS 14 days, ACN 15 days, SCHW 29 days, TRV 30 days), or are overcrowded growth plays at stretched multiples (PLTR 147x PE, ANET 59x with 81% range position). One disciplined trade, the rest in cash.

trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL — Adobe is trading at 9.31x forward earnings and a PEG of 0.64, both historically cheap for a business with 61.9% ROE, 34.8% operating margins, $9.1B in annual FCF, and 12.9% revenue growth. The AI-integration narrative (Firefly, generative tools across Creative Cloud) supports re-acceleration. The stock has de-rated sharply from its highs on competitive AI fears — those fears appear increasingly priced in at current multiples. TECHNICAL — At 37% of the 52-week range and -3.1% vs SMA200, this is a basing setup in the lower half, not a late-cycle chase. SMA50 slope has accelerated to +10.4% over 20 days, suggesting institutional accumulation. Price is close to SMA50 (+1.4%), offering a well-defined risk level. Earnings are Dec 9 (84 days), providing a clean multi-month holding window. Stop at 2x ATR(14) = $22.16 below entry = $235.60, which is below recent basing support. Position sized at 38 shares (~$9,795) — uses available $9,800 headroom, risks ~$842 (0.87% of equity), well within 1-2% per-trade risk budget.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) stop at $235.60 is hit — thesis invalid; (2) price closes below $245 on high volume suggesting distribution before stop is formally triggered; (3) fundamental thesis breaks — e.g., a major revenue guidance cut at Dec earnings, or evidence of structural market share loss to AI competitors; (4) position held past 12 months and thesis is intact — reassess at Dec 2027 for LTCG treatment. If stock reaches $295-300 (~15% gain), raise stop to breakeven and let the rest run toward $310 target.
